reviewed_context_transfers.basis: Native instruction bodies match the reviewed same-release Lua context boundaries byte for byte through their transfer instruction.

reviewed_float_storage_views.basis: The recovered VM stack slots alternate pointer words and floating values; pointer branches retain their raw four-byte representations.

reviewed_virtual_owner_calls.basis: Deleting destructor slot and reference-count guarded control-block release preserve the native owner argument.

reviewed_pic_state_anchors.basis: Immutable native PC constants and their immutable scalar aliases plus constant offsets resolving into module data.

reviewed_inline_dispatch_tables.basis: Native PC-relative signed offsets terminating at the first word that cannot resolve to module text.

reviewed_lexer_pic_slot.basis: Native lexer retains the PC anchor in its fourth stack word; its first three words are a separate string view. Two bounded character tables cover 94 and 93 entries.

reviewed_float_pointer_stack_slots.basis: Both interpreters reuse four-byte stack words for native pointers and scalar values. Native integer loads of pointer fields must preserve raw bits; numeric conversion is retained in other functions.

reviewed_parameter_stack_spills.basis: Native stores VM, aggregate output and PC anchor at ESP+0x28, ESP+0x24 and ESP+0x2c. The later dynamic stack views read those words; restore stores omitted from decompiler C.

reviewed_interpreter_pc_tables.basis: Reviewed native bounds select signed table offsets relative to PC 10041674. C switches compare native numeric labels while storing their table words as source data.

reviewed_scalar_word_casts.basis: Clang token p-code shows CAST operations for integral views of these four-byte floating-typed temporaries; no FLOAT_TRUNC operations occur among their 967 uses. Preserve representation bits for those casts.

reviewed_callable_vm_spill.basis: Native caches the VM at ESP+0x24; the C stack view restores that word and the common post-call stack origin.

reviewed_x87_exponential_argument: Native expl loads a ten-byte argument from a twelve-byte i386 stack slot and returns through the full ST0 register.

reviewed_allocator_forwarding.reason: Native allocator tail calls preserve byte-count and pointer arguments through the WMAP wire table. Explicit call contracts retain those arguments in C.
